say:1:1060900001:0.text: Salutations, dear patrons! 'Tis I, Mr. Keith, a humble merchant.
say:1:1060900001:0.source_cn: 朋友们好！初次见面，你们可以称呼我为基斯先生。

say:2:1060900002:0.text: Step right up and behold the wonders of the Treasure Hut! It's plain as day that you'll find a heap of splendid treasures here.
say:2:1060900002:0.source_cn: 欢迎来到奇珍屋！想必你们看我的模样就知道我这里有不少好货！

say:3:1060900003:0.text: Special offers that'll tickle your fancy like nowhere else! Don't dilly-dally, get the best bargain and seize this opportunity today!
say:3:1060900003:0.source_cn: 只有我这里才会有的特价优惠！你们不会再找到更便宜的，机...
